title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states B = m v0 / (q R) from balancing Lorentz force and centripetal force for circular motion in the magnetic field.

title: Angular velocity for A
description: Essential: Correctly derives ω = (4k+1) v0/R by matching the ion's quarter-period in the field with the cylinder's rotation to align the hole S with the exit point.

title: Average force at C
description: Important: Applies impulse-momentum theorem correctly, relating average force over one revolution period (2π/ω') to the total momentum change (N m v) of the ions striking at C.

title: Velocity and geometry at C
description: Important: Correctly relates the ion's velocity v at detection point C (with angle θ) to v0 using geometry and circular motion, finding v = v0 tan(θ/2) and the corresponding radius.

title: Angular velocity for C
description: Important: Correctly derives the general angular velocity ω' = (2nπ+θ)v0 / [R(π-θ)] by matching the ion's travel time in the magnetic field (arc length π-θ) with the cylinder's rotation to align the hole.

title: Other detection angles
description: Important: Correctly solves the inequality ω' < 6v0/R with ω' expressed in terms of θ' to find the other possible detection angles θ' = π/6 and 5π/6.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for charge in Lorentz force (e.g., forgetting the ion has charge -q) or misidentifies the direction of force/deflection.

title: Time-period mismatch
description: Pitfall: Fails to correctly relate the ion's travel time in the magnetic field to the cylinder's rotation angle (ωt = 2kπ + constant), leading to wrong expressions for ω or ω'.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions for B, ω, and F (e.g., force has units of mass*acceleration).
